name: Nitta Gelatin India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1975, Nitta Gelatin India Ltd manufactures and sells ossein, gelatin, and collagen peptide[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
NGIL, a joint venture between the Kerala State Industrial Development Corporation (32% shareholding) and Osaka-based NGI (43% stake), manufactures gelatin, ossein, limed ossein, and DCP from processed animal bones. It also produces collagen peptide-based consumer products for the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 46.2% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.26% over past five years.
